articles.summary: Babbel Chief Executive Officer Tim Allen Appointed to the Board USA TODAY Co., Inc. (“USA TODAY Co.”, “we”, “us”, “our”, or the “Company”) (NYSE: TDAY) today announced that its Board of Directors has appointed Tim Allen, Chief Executive Officer of Babbel, to the Company’s Board of Directors. “We are pleased to announce Tim’s appointment and excited to welcome him to the Board. Tim brings an exceptional combination of leadership, digital innovation expertise, and consumer-focused growth experience,” said Michael Reed, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of USA TODAY Co. “Tim’s deep understanding of subscription and direct-to-consumer business models, and track record leveraging technology and AI to drive growth and deepen customer engagement will be invaluable as we continue expanding our digital opportunities. articles.summary: Complementary Transaction Supports Local Journalism in Arizona, Montana and South Dakota USA TODAY Co., Inc. (NYSE: TDAY) and Lee Enterprises, Incorporated (NASDAQ: LEE) announced today strategic agreements that signal an exciting next chapter for both organizations, effective immediately. The agreements conclude TNI Partners, the joint venture involving the Arizona Daily Star, where Lee Enterprises led the Arizona Daily Star’s newsroom, production and related technology operations, while USA TODAY Co. managed advertising and sales, accounting and finance functions. USA TODAY Co. will assume full ownership and operations of the Arizona Daily Star. This marks the beginning of a new chapter for local journalism and community engagement across Arizona where USA TODAY Co. owns The Arizona Republic.
